description: This file handles parsing and processing of chat message attachments, including image validation, offloading large media to disk, and constructing message content with embedded images or media references.

classes.name: MediaOffloadError
classes.description: Custom error class for failures when persisting media to the media store.

methods.name: normalizeMime
methods.description: Normalizes MIME types by trimming, lowercasing, and removing parameters.

methods.name: isImageMime
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is an image type.

methods.name: isValidBase64
methods.description: Validates if a string is valid base64.

methods.name: verifyDecodedSize
methods.description: Verifies that the decoded size of base64 data matches the estimated size.

methods.name: ensureExtension
methods.description: Ensures filename has an extension based on MIME type.

methods.name: assertSavedMedia
methods.description: Validates the shape and safety of the saved media object.

methods.name: normalizeAttachment
methods.description: Normalizes attachment data, extracting base64 content and MIME type.

methods.name: validateAttachmentBase64OrThrow
methods.description: Validates base64 content size and correctness.

methods.name: parseMessageWithAttachments
methods.description: Parses message and attachments, offloading large images, validating, and constructing message content.

methods.name: buildMessageWithAttachments
methods.description: Builds message content with inline base64 images (deprecated).
